mapper.select: SELECT code AS company_code, countycode AS county_code, parkcode AS park_code, yq_type, is_scqy FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.accept_company

SELECT a.company_code, MAX(CASE WHEN a.tickek_state = 1 AND a.ticket_activity = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_full, MAX(CASE WHEN (a.tickek_state = 1 AND a.ticket_activity = 0) OR (a.tickek_state = 0 AND a.ticket_activity = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_partial, MAX(CASE WHEN a.tickek_state = 0 AND a.ticket_activity = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_not FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.all_access_status a GROUP BY a.company_code

SELECT t.company_code, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_0, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_1, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_3, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = '4' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_4, SUM(CASE WHEN t.ticket_status = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status_5 FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.accept_ticket_formal t WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.company_code

SELECT t.company_code, COALESCE(z.zydl, '未分类') AS type_name, COUNT(*) AS type_count FROM zlkj_danger_data_accept.accept_ticket_formal t LEFT JOIN zlkj_danger_data_accept.zylxflb z ON t.ticket_type = z.xlbm WHERE t.deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.company_code, z.zydl
